findings.economic_impact: FY2019 flows include January-April before the cutoff and could overstate post-cutoff management execution if later evaluation treats them as causal.
findings.missing_fact_or_control: Machine-readable measurement-use and causal-credit eligibility linked from settlement cells to utility findings.
findings.prohibited_assumption: Full-year volume, share, margin or cash improvement was caused by a post-cutoff management action.
findings.required_remediation: Assign mixed-clock cells descriptive or error-avoidance use only with causal_credit NONE, and require future utility findings to cite eligible cell IDs.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Changing any mixed-clock cell to positive causal credit must fail validation.

findings.economic_impact: National parcel growth or issuer-minus-industry spread could be mistaken for company capability even though price, platform traffic and a correctly bounded industry reference remain unresolved.
findings.missing_fact_or_control: An independent industry responsibility perimeter and separately bound industry source fields.
findings.prohibited_assumption: Growth spread, share gain or complaint improvement alone proves customer preference, execution or moat.
findings.required_remediation: Keep the frozen contract unchanged, settle the affected Round 8 cells as local MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH, and require a separate industry perimeter in the next unseen episode.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Future validators reject national industry fields bound to an issuer-consolidated perimeter.

findings.economic_impact: A role that ignores the procedural boundary could manually open the predeclared outcome PDF before freeze.
findings.missing_fact_or_control: Adversarial isolation of source content from the research role.
findings.prohibited_assumption: The SEALED label is a security boundary.
findings.required_remediation: Reviewer proposed hiding the exact source identity until post-freeze custody.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Reviewer proposed rejecting exact post-cutoff URLs in pre-outcome packages.
findings.disposition_reason: This local collaborator system intentionally predeclares exact source identity to prevent result-based source selection. Content isolation is recorded as procedural, not adversarial; hiding source identity would move source choice after freeze and weaken the sampling contract.

passed_controls: Baseline and Enhanced use the same evidence-locator union.
The Baseline contains material caveats and is not intentionally weakened.
The eight dimensions are a no-score judgment skeleton, not eight global gates.
No FY2019 realized value or direction label appears in the frozen pre-outcome package.
